propositions: DC-side bidirectional reconciliation cannot be proven against an empty local store; it requires a copy of the real production ticket inventory with realistic volume, ticket shapes, link graphs, and comment histories
reconciler AUTO-COMMITS and AUTO-PUSHES to sync.remote, creating isolation hazards; primary defense is a fresh git init with no remote, enforced by assertion
the store copy must be scrubbed of production Jira bindings and reconciler artifacts (`.bridge_state*` pattern) because leftover bindings cause outbound mutations to target production issue keys

isolated test passes must assert both directions separately: inbound create reaching local store AND outbound edit reaching DC instance, each with oracle-based verification of field values after round-trip

snapshot-differ field-drift phantom mutations (where prior-pass state differs from current Jira state) cause unconvergeable mutation lists that revert writes and mask product defects in soft-failed exceptions
